title: Long-term follow-up of patients treated with GD2IL18CART
summary: The study addresses the long-term observation of patients with cancers who were treated in a clinical trial with a novel immunotherapy, called GD2IL18CART. In accordance with regulatory requirements, the long-term effects of the treatment and its long-term benefits will be investigated during an extended follow-up of 15 years.
conditions: Malignant neoplasm of bone and articular cartilage of other and unspecified sites
Malignant neoplasm of bone and articular cartilage of limbs
Malignant neoplasm: Medulla of adrenal gland

interventions.name: Long-term follow-up of patients treated with GD2IL18CART (EU CT No. 2022-501725-21-00). Starts one year after administration of the GD2IL18CART cells. The patients will be followed up for up to 14 more years (after 1 year of observation in the therapy study) (i.e. a total of 15 years after IMP admin

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Patient underwent treatment with GD2IL18CART in the primary trial prior to enrollment into long-term follow-up.
2. Patient and/or caregivers have provided informed consent at any time prior to the first trial-specific assessment.
Exclusion criteria:
No exclusion criteria are defined for this long-term follow-up trial.
